# Margo Hairstylist, full content for AI ingestion

## About

Margo Hairstylist is a qualified hairstylist with a home studio in Snells Beach, Auckland, New Zealand. Margo studied and worked at Servilles, and worked at Rodney Wayne, building a loyal following in Auckland before opening her own studio in Snells Beach, and many clients still travel to see her. She is known for listening well, having a good eye for what suits each client, and caring for the health of the hair as much as the finished look. She works with products she trusts. Forever a student of hair herself, Margo is always learning and happy to share what she knows and give honest advice, so you can look after your hair at home. She is rated 4.9 out of 5 on Google.

## Services

- Cuts & Styling: women, men and kids. Cuts shaped to suit the client and to grow out well, finished with a proper blow wave.
- Colour: full colour, root touch-ups, foils and balayage using professional Wella colour, always mindful of the health of the hair.
- Smoothing & Straightening: permanent hair straightening, nanoplastia, keratin and smooth filler, different ways to leave the frizz behind.
- Curly Hair: cutting and styling that works with the natural curl pattern rather than against it.
- Treatments & Blow Waves: deep hydration treatments and professional blow waves, using the products Margo trusts.

Pricing is by consultation, so clients always know the cost before starting. Reviews consistently describe the prices as reasonable and excellent value.

## Products (professional hair care)

Margo keeps the professional products she trusts in the studio on a shelf in the studio: Wella (Ultimate Repair, Ultimate Smooth, Ultimate Colour, Nutri Curls), Paul Mitchell, De Lorenzo, Argila and Angel, covering shampoos, conditioning treatments, styling and finishing sprays, colour-protect masks and gift sets. They are not sold online and are not shipped. Margo shows what she stocks so you know what is available, tells you honestly which one suits your hair, and you collect and pay at your appointment. To ask whether something is in stock, text or call 021 202 9441.
